name: Bentley Continental GTC
description: The Bentley Continental GTC is the convertible variant of Bentley's iconic grand tourer, combining breathtaking performance with open-air luxury. This tuned 635 Racing variant enhances the twin-turbocharged 6.0-liter W12 engine to produce 700 hp and 830 Nm of torque. The Continental GTC features Bentley's sophisticated all-wheel-drive system with an eight-speed dual-clutch transmission. The retractable soft top transforms between coupe and convertible in just 19 seconds at speeds up to 50 km/h. Inside, the cabin showcases Bentley's legendary craftsmanship with hand-stitched leather, real wood veneers, and the signature rotating display. The Continental GTC represents the pinnacle of grand touring convertibles, offering supercar performance wrapped in quintessential British luxury.
author: Ceky Performance
